newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER'S MORATTI SAYS CLOSE TO RONALDO DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER'S MORATTI SAYS CLOSE TO RONALDO DEAL.

text.p: Internazionale president Massimo Moratti said on Wednesday he hoped the Italian serie A club would sign Brazilian striker Ronaldo from Barcelona in the next few days.
"I hope to give the announcement by the end of the week," Moratti told reporters. "Let us hope so for Italian soccer and for Inter."
Ronaldo said last week he would definitely leave Barcelona, contradicting the club's previous announcement that the 20-year-old striker had signed for another nine years at $3.5 million a season.
The world footballer of the year is said to be unhappy about the way he has been treated at the Spanish club and over problems with payment of a $14 million one-off bonus.
